description: This Java source file defines the annotation interface `@JsonParsableCommand`, which is used to mark classes as deserializable from JSON commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. The annotation specifies command name, type prefix, and method name for deserialization.

classes.name: JsonParsableCommand
classes.description: An annotation interface used to mark classes as deserializable commands from JSON, specifying command name, type prefix, and method name.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the command.

methods.name: typePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix of the command.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Returns the name of the method used for JSON deserialization, defaulting to 'fromJson'.
